scope: Bounded pre-holdout regime partition contract over an offline synthetic fixture; no production dataset, holdout content, broker, provider, or deployment access

tests.command: uv run --project . --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_u5c_oos.py -q

accepted_scope: Caller-supplied regime labels are validated against a safe label grammar and bounded unique-label count
Every label carries a non-future integer known_at timestamp no later than its observed bar timestamp
Contiguous regime segments and per-label counts are deterministic and chronologically indexed
Metadata-only holdout boundary is enforced before partitioning and never grants holdout access
residual_scope: Research API/job protocol and worker integration that runs or reports per-regime engine outcomes
Regime classifier/provider selection and licensed real-data OOS evidence
Stress scenario ranking, edge claims, holdout evaluation, broker/demo/live, provider and deployment acceptance
